english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for altering or repairing existing clothes; making a new garment from scratch is usually expressed differently.

exampleSentences.english: These trousers are too long, so I need to tailor them.
exampleSentences.traditional: 條褲太長，我要拎去改衫。
exampleSentences.jyutping: tiu4 fu3 taai3 coeng4 ngo5 jiu3 ling1 heoi3 goi2 saam1

english.note: Use 改衫 specifically when a tailor alters clothing so that it fits.

exampleSentences.english: I need to take these trousers to a tailor to alter them so they fit.
exampleSentences.traditional: 呢條褲要拎去改衫，先至啱身。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ni1 tiu4 fu3 jiu3 ling1 heoi3 goi2 saam1 sin1 zi3 ngaam1 san1
